Participants braved cold weather to tackle the 13.1-mile course from Brooklyn through Manhattan, passing iconic landmarks. Notable winners included Hellen Obiri who set a new course record of 1:06:33. The 2026 United Airlines NYC Half is a 13.1-mile race held earlier today in New York City.
